scientific_rationale: Holding L093 under the frozen cn_conditional contract. Enabled terms only: endpoint 0.4, half 0.3, type 0.3; orientation weight is 0.0 and is not described. Direct geometry support is the local subset atom_slots [8,12,18,21,22]; typed_slots [8,12,22] carry the only type loss, so slots 18 and 21 are context neighbors with direct geometry constraint only, not free background. Points outside atom_slots remain free and can still move via model-mediated gradients; that is global response, distinct from direct local support. Type reward reads selected decoder N/C log probabilities on fixed coordinates; gradients act only on current coordinates through real coordinate and atomic-decoder Jacobians. No affinity differentiation, no discrete-label override, no graph freezing, no SMC. Labels are counterfactual hypotheses on fixed coordinates, not an observed continuation state: slot 12 native C -> desired N (N_targets [12]), slot 22 native N -> desired C (compensating C site), slot 8 native C -> desired C (identity anchor). This is a joint swap, not N addition with the former N untouched. The generated N decoder channel is treated as generic N until final chemical-role checks; the exchange_class excludes pyrrole [nH] and amide N, and the aromatic N donor-facing match is a geometry proxy, not a validated affinity rule. Expected observable changes if activated: slot 12 enriched toward N and slot 22 shifted toward C beyond the unguided control, with slot 8 held as C; geometry read from final_local_geometry_rms_A and cumulative_control_RMS_A against the frozen R13_reference control (0.5286, 0.5975). Decision is defer, not activate: the intervention is bounded relative site importance from finite layout contrast magnitude, and the supplied evidence already undercuts that ordering. The largest-magnitude finite contrast sits on slot 8 (N_minus_C -0.413636), a C-retaining site, not on the N_target slot 12 (+0.306751); contrast magnitude therefore does not rank N preference at these sites. Prior L093 runs at type weight 0.3 (R04/R07/R09) gave local_NC_identity_accuracy 0.375/0.375/0.347 with aromatic_N_role_fraction 0.0 and best_qualified_pic50 8.1289, all below the R13_reference incumbent 8.378002, despite nonzero type gradient (max_type_gradient_rms 0.2303-0.2511, max_type_mixture_input_rms 0.3000). A nonzero type gradient did not translate into identity response, and reduced imitation loss or higher identity accuracy is not success; terminal affinity is the outcome. The best legal counterfactual targets have not been regenerated or relaxed, so they are not observed successful paths. Deferring without inventing evidence; no teacher substitution, no added background points, no alternate region.
